reason: The press is already answered in the fixed tree: the summary mark flips + to − and the count goes from fore-62 to full ink, so opening is acknowledged, not silent. What is left is an entrance on the revealed rows — the class refuted this round. The fix also breaks the lock twice: a 40ms stagger is off the declared ladder (0.08 / 0.14 / 0.22), and shell.css zeroes animation-duration but not animation-delay, so reduced-motion readers still get the cascade. Animation shorthand is invisible to the audit gate, which reads transitions only.
sharpenedFix: None required; the reveal is correct as painted. If press feedback is ever revisited, an on-demand reveal is a fair case to argue — but keep it to opacity only on .b-behindList as one block, 0.14s var(--ease), no transform, no per-row stagger and no animation-delay, and express it as a transition so the audit gate can see the duration. Ship only if a side-by-side on a 390px phone shows the snap actually reading as a fault.
